landing.tariffsLead: Pick a plan to create an organization. You can change it later.
landing.retentionForever: Audio kept until you delete it
landing.faqLead: For IT, security, and process owners in large organizations.
landing.faq1q: Is this built for enterprise and on-premise?
landing.faq1a: Yes. idigest-hub is a self-hosted control plane: it runs inside your perimeter (Docker, your PostgreSQL), with no SaaS data egress. Users only touch the hub; the instance admin connects transcription and summarization workers that stay on your infrastructure.
landing.faq2q: How do you ensure data sovereignty and control?
landing.faq2a: Audio, transcripts, and summaries live on your disk (./data volume) or attached storage. Retention is governed by each org's plan. Employees never see worker URLs or tokens — access goes through the hub with role-based permissions.
landing.faq3a: Yes. Each organization can enable OIDC — compatible with Keycloak and other OpenID Connect IdPs. Org admins turn on SSO in settings; employees sign in through the corporate provider without separate service passwords.
landing.faq4q: How are departments and teams isolated?
landing.faq4a: Each organization is a separate tenant: its own plan, wallet, members, and roles (org_admin / org_member). The instance admin manages plans and quotas centrally; org admins run users, SSO, and stats for their unit. Artifact sharing stays within the org.
landing.faq5q: Is there audit, billing, and an API for integrations?
landing.faq5a: Every org has a wallet and operation ledger; the instance admin can credit or debit balances with audit logging. Usage is metered per plan for transcription and summarization. API tokens are plan-gated; jobs can be submitted via REST to fit enterprise workflows.
landing.faq6q: How do we monitor and run it in production?
landing.faq6a: The hub exposes Prometheus metrics (/metrics) and ships a Grafana dashboard. Rate limits, health checks, and HTTPS at the instance level are supported. For production resilience, use PostgreSQL instead of SQLite and dedicated workers balanced by the instance admin.

encryption.title: Encryption management
encryption.lead: Data encryption keys (DEK). Add a new DEK if a key may be compromised, then re-encrypt to retire old keys. After changing HUB_SECRET, set HUB_SECRET_PREV to the old value and restart — DEK re-wrap runs automatically on startup.
encryption.hubSecretPrevHint: HUB_SECRET_PREV is set. Keep it until all DEKs show as re-wrapped (restart is safe mid-rotation).
encryption.rewrapPending: {{count}} DEK(s) still need re-wrap — check HUB_SECRET / HUB_SECRET_PREV and restart.
